{{Infobox auto}}

'''Glow berry jam''' is the preservation of [[glow berries]]. It heals {{Hp|4}} and grants the Aura intrinsic for 30 seconds, making every other creature within 50 blocks glow.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/glow_jam.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Glow berry mash]], sugar and a glass bottle. Obtaining glow berry mash unlocks the recipe.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating glow berry jam takes 1.6 seconds and heals {{Hp|4}}. A bell sound plays, and 2.4 seconds later every other entity within 50 blocks glows for 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/soul_sight_apply_glow_30.mcfunction}}</ref> It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
